terms_of_service.title: Terms of Service
terms_of_service.body:
These terms govern your use of the app. By creating an account you agree to use the service only for its intended purpose: managing and understanding your personal finances.

The insights, suggestions, and answers generated by the AI assistant are informational only — they are not professional financial, investment, tax, or legal advice, and you should not rely on them as a substitute for advice from a licensed professional before making significant financial decisions.

You're responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for the accuracy of the information you provide, including any bank connections and uploaded statements. You agree not to use the service to submit data you don't have the right to share, or to attempt to disrupt, reverse-engineer, or abuse the platform.

We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, misuse the service, or pose a security risk to other users. You may close your account at any time from your profile page, which permanently deletes your data.

We may update these terms as the product evolves; continuing to use the app after an update means you accept the revised terms.

data_processing.title: Data Processing
data_processing.body:
To build and maintain your personalized financial plan, we process the data you choose to share with the app: bank account and transaction data (whether linked directly or uploaded as statements), the budgets and goals you set, and the messages you send in chat.

Generating AI-powered insights and chat replies sends the relevant parts of this data — never your bank login credentials — to OpenAI for processing. Uploaded statements are also processed through OCR to extract transaction data automatically. We don't sell your financial data to advertisers, data brokers, or anyone else, for any reason.

Your data is stored securely and used only to power features you've enabled — turning this consent off stops new statements from being processed and pauses the chat assistant, without deleting data already on file. Emails related to your account (verification, password resets, notifications) are sent through Gmail.

You can review, correct, or export most of your data at any time from your profile page, and permanently delete your account and everything associated with it whenever you choose to.
